sources.snippet: The MuJoCo file scene.xml supports two differenly calibrated SO101 robot files: New Calibration (Default): Each joint's virtual zero is set to the middle of its joint range. Use -> so101_new_calib.xml. Old Calibration: Each joint's virtual zero is set to the configuration where the robot is fully extended horizontally. Use -> so101_old_calib.xml.
